title: Birth
meaning: The beginning of the journey. Every soul enters the game.
reflection: What am I beginning right now?

title: Illusion
meaning: The veil of appearances that hides deeper truth.
reflection: Where am I mistaking appearance for reality?

title: Anger
meaning: The fire that burns without wisdom.
reflection: What anger am I holding that no longer serves me?

title: Greed
meaning: The endless wanting that is never satisfied.
reflection: Where am I grasping instead of receiving?

title: Physical Plane
meaning: The realm of matter, sensation, and earthly experience.
reflection: How am I honoring my body and physical presence?

title: Delusion
meaning: Attachment to the unreal as if it were real.
reflection: What story am I telling myself that isn't true?

title: Vanity
meaning: Pride that separates us from truth and others.
reflection: Where is my ego asking to be seen instead of serving?

title: Envy
meaning: The poison of comparing your inside to another's outside.
reflection: Who am I comparing myself to, and why?

title: Sensual Plane
meaning: The realm of desire, pleasure, and earthly attachment.
reflection: What am I chasing that I think will complete me?

title: Purification
meaning: Cleansing of old patterns to reveal what is real.
reflection: What old layer am I ready to release?

title: Entertainment Plane
meaning: The world of art, music, beauty, and creative expression.
reflection: Where can I bring more beauty and play into my life?

title: Jealousy
meaning: Fear disguised as possessiveness.
reflection: What am I afraid of losing?

title: Right Action
meaning: Aligned action that serves the whole.
reflection: What is mine to do right now?

title: Astral Plane
meaning: The realm of energy, emotion, and subtle perception.
reflection: What am I feeling beneath the surface?

title: Desire
meaning: The longing that moves us toward union or distraction.
reflection: Is this desire pulling me closer to truth or further from it?

title: Good Tendencies
meaning: Actions rooted in kindness and clarity.
reflection: What good am I doing that I haven't acknowledged?

title: Mercy
meaning: Compassion that holds suffering with presence.
reflection: Who needs my compassion right now—including myself?

title: Heavenly Plane
meaning: The realm of joy, light, and temporary bliss.
reflection: What brings me joy without clinging?

title: Wrong Action
meaning: Action that harms the self or others.
reflection: Where have I acted out of alignment?

title: Discernment
meaning: The capacity to see what is real and what is not.
reflection: What truth am I avoiding?

title: Selfless Service
meaning: Giving without attachment to outcome or recognition.
reflection: How can I serve without needing to be seen?

title: Mental Plane
meaning: The realm of thought, intellect, and mental clarity.
reflection: What thoughts are running my life?

title: Good Company
meaning: The mirror of those who reflect truth back to you.
reflection: Who in my life helps me see clearly?

title: Bad Company
meaning: Relationships that pull you away from your center.
reflection: Who or what am I letting influence me unconsciously?

title: Charity
meaning: Generosity of spirit, resources, and presence.
reflection: What am I being called to give?

title: Piety
meaning: Devotion to what is sacred and true.
reflection: What do I hold as sacred in my life?

title: Plane of Austerity
meaning: The realm of discipline, sacrifice, and refinement.
reflection: What discipline is shaping me right now?

title: Correct Knowledge
meaning: Truth that aligns with reality, not belief.
reflection: What do I know to be true, beyond opinion?

title: Neutral Tendencies
meaning: Neither seeking nor avoiding, just present.
reflection: Where am I trying too hard to control the outcome?

title: Good Karma
meaning: The fruit of aligned action.
reflection: What harvest am I reaping from past choices?

title: Plane of Bliss
meaning: The realm of deep peace, stillness, and inner knowing.
reflection: When was the last time I felt truly at peace?

title: Plane of Balance
meaning: A place of balance, integration, and stabilization before entering deeper self-realization.
reflection: Where am I being asked to stabilize my energy before making the next move?

title: Plane of Fragrance
meaning: The subtle realm where essence is perceived before form.
reflection: What am I sensing before it becomes visible?

title: Plane of Taste
meaning: The realm of flavor, preference, and aesthetic discernment.
reflection: What is the flavor of my current experience?

title: Purgatory
meaning: The underworld of consequence and purification.
reflection: What consequence am I facing that I have been avoiding?

title: Clarity of Consciousness
meaning: The clear mirror of awareness, unstained by thought.
reflection: What becomes visible when I stop narrating my experience?

title: Wisdom
meaning: Wisdom as embodied knowing. This is not just information, but self-realized action.
reflection: What do I already know, but have not yet trusted?

title: Plane of Reality
meaning: The realm of absolute truth, beyond perception.
reflection: What is real when all stories fall away?

title: Inner Space
meaning: The gap between thoughts where presence lives.
reflection: Where is the silence in my life?

title: Plane of Luminosity
meaning: The radiant dimension where light is self-aware.
reflection: What in me is already awake?

title: Cosmic Consciousness
meaning: Union with the infinite field of awareness.
reflection: When have I felt most connected to everything?

title: Plane of Birth and Rebirth
meaning: The cycle of return, again and again, until freedom.
reflection: What pattern keeps repeating in my life?

title: Humanity
meaning: The beautiful, flawed, holy experience of being human.
reflection: Where am I being too hard on myself for being human?

title: Ignorance
meaning: Not knowing what you do not know.
reflection: What blind spot is becoming visible?

title: Bad Tendencies
meaning: Patterns that lead away from wholeness.
reflection: What habit am I defending that doesn't serve me?

title: Egotism
meaning: The false sense of a separate, solid self.
reflection: Where am I taking things personally that aren't about me?

title: Conscience
meaning: The inner voice that knows right from wrong.
reflection: What is my conscience telling me that I am ignoring?

title: Spiritual Devotion
meaning: Surrender to what is greater than the personal self.
reflection: What am I being asked to trust?

title: Phenomenal Plane
meaning: The manifest world of form, change, and appearance.
reflection: What am I treating as permanent that is obviously changing?

title: Fluid Energy
meaning: The water element—flow, adaptability, and emotional depth.
reflection: Where do I need to soften and flow instead of resist?

title: False Knowledge
meaning: Believing something untrue to be true.
reflection: What 'fact' am I holding that might just be a story?

title: Plane of Violence
meaning: The realm where harm is inflicted, consciously or not.
reflection: Where am I being violent—toward myself or others?

title: Earth Energy
meaning: The grounding element of stability, form, and matter.
reflection: How am I grounding myself in the present moment?

title: Fire Energy
meaning: The transforming element of heat, digestion, and light.
reflection: What in me is being burned away?

title: Attachment
meaning: The sticky grip of wanting things to stay as they are.
reflection: What am I clinging to that wants to leave?

title: Air Energy
meaning: The moving element of breath, wind, and change.
reflection: What new wind is blowing through my life?

title: Ether
meaning: The spacious element that holds all other elements.
reflection: Where do I need more space in my life?

title: Supreme Energy
meaning: The unchanging awareness beneath all experience.
reflection: What in me has never changed?

title: Absolute Self
meaning: The true self, beyond body, mind, and identity.
reflection: Who am I when no one is looking?

title: Plane of Primal Vibration
meaning: The realm of sound, frequency, and the creative word.
reflection: What is the sound of my soul right now?

title: Primal Vibration
meaning: The first sound, the cosmic hum, the resonance of all that is.
reflection: When I sit in silence, what vibration do I feel?

title: Supreme Bliss
meaning: The bliss that is not dependent on anything external.
reflection: When was the last time I felt joy for no reason?

title: Plane of the Dark Night
meaning: The underworld journey where light is temporarily hidden.
reflection: What darkness am I afraid to sit with?

title: Plane of Non-Duality
meaning: The realm where separation dissolves into oneness.
reflection: Where am I creating a boundary that doesn't exist?

title: Void
meaning: Emptiness that is full, the ground of all form.
reflection: What happens when I stop filling the silence?

title: Plane of Renunciation
meaning: The realm of letting go without aversion.
reflection: What am I ready to release with love?

title: Reality
meaning: That which is, always has been, and always will be.
reflection: What is here that cannot be taken away?

title: Cosmic Good
meaning: The goodness woven into the fabric of existence.
reflection: Where can I trust that life is supporting me?

title: Absolute Truth
meaning: The truth beyond all relative truths.
reflection: What do I know that cannot be argued with?

title: Plane of Saturation
meaning: The fullness where nothing more is needed.
reflection: Where am I already complete?

title: Universal Consciousness
meaning: Awareness that includes all beings, all worlds, all experience.
reflection: What would I do if I knew we are all one?

title: Liberation
meaning: Freedom from the game. You have arrived.
reflection: What does it feel like to be free?
